title: Great UI and Idea but Terrible Execution
body: I want to love this app. It has a great UI and it’s very simplistic and user friendly. However, I paid for the All-Access Pass as well as the Apple Music Integration Pass and it won’t play song snippets like it says you can, even with the setting turned on. Additionally, I can’t even play the single-player mode because it wants you to create a username, and when I try to submit the username, it seems like the submit button doesn’t even work. Every other aspect of this app is solid, but considering that I can’t even play single-player mode and the multiplayer mode won’t play random snippets from a song, the app is just pointless for me; as there is no difference from just starting a random playlist on Apple Music or Spotify and guessing the song and skipping to the next and repeating that.

title: Music doesn't play
body: When I tried to play the game, it wouldn't play the music. This has happened every time and every time it wastes my tickets. Would love to play this game but need this bug fixed ASAP. Thank you for your patience and support - Kai

title: Love this game but glitchy
body: My friends and I love playing this game, but when hosting a game it will not connect and start the game. We need to restart the app multiple times to get it to work. When it does work I love this game!

title: Bugs
body: The app is great but the sometimes the song doesn’t play at all and I have to guess with no audio. Other times it guesses for me and chooses the correct one but I get no points. One time while I was choosing modes it chose the wrong mode despite me choosing a different option. I would rate it 5 starts if it worked.

title: Custom albums
body: The game is pretty cool. Ive played it with my family a few times and at first had no problem. But then, when we tried to play together with one of the playlists i created myself, it kept freezing and would only let the host guess. Overall great game, just wish we could all play together using custom playlists.

title: Good app
body: So I downloaded this for me and my friend and it works great! There’s no ads and almost no glitches. The only thing that is ruining it for me is that when I’m about halfway through a round, it loads and it doesn’t stop. And I can’t exit; I can only close the app.

title: Huge bug with the anticheat
body: Sometimes when I do one of the quizzes, my app freezes for a split second, which makes the anticheat think I paused the song.

title: Cool app but struggling
body: This app really is great and there’s a huge playlist selection! I don’t know if it’s a bug on my end or something with the app but whenever i’m in a duel and click on the album to play or pick a new playlist the entire app freezes. the only way to fix it is by closing the app out entirely and loading back in… every single time. idk if it’s my phone or the app but it’s still fun just wish I didn’t have to do it everytime 😭

body: I love this app so much because I get to guess songs and it reminds me of music trivia and I really love it so much because I love music trivia and music is my whole life. I think you for inviting me to one of your guys reviews and I hope that she’ll read this message. Thank you so much.

title: Coworkers and I love the game for downtime.

Besides that though this game is wonderful!!

title: Fantastic game!
body: Update 5/1/24: Still having this bug and I really miss this game! I check every few weeks to see if it’s fixed. Please fix this!! I really love this game and I miss it so much! Username still says “not your username” and still have no tickets. I have uninstalled the app and reinstalled, signed out but it won’t let me sign back in. I close the app and it brings me back to the home page and I’m “logged” in with the “not your username”. Please please please fix this!!! This is by far the best guess the song game ever! Everything is amazing! Recently I’ve ran into an issue, it says “not your username” where my original username was and I’ve lost all my tickets. I’ve deleted the game for a few months and got it back today still says the same thing. Please fix this for me, I absolutely love this app and I would love to keep playing.
